method: Fit a pooled distribution of certain paragraph word lengths and line capacities on the public ZL training pages. To fill each synthetic paragraph line, draw independently from the pooled word lengths that fit in its remaining capacity, counting one separator between words. Stop when the remaining room admits no positive-length word. This same conditional draw is used at every position and never names the final position or the one-to-three-glyph threshold. The ordinary capacity is 60 units, the training 75th percentile, and paragraph-end capacities come from the clean training paragraph ends capped at 60. Encode each sampled length as a nonlinguistic artificial word. Supply 5,225 lines for the whole book. Freeze seed 643701 for submission. On public practice all five capacity-fit draws pass F-023; controls using independent original slot counts or greedy wrap with an overflow carried to the next line pass zero of five each. The first capacity-fit ratio is 2.249192 with p=.0025, while the same measurement is 1.157454 on the public manuscript evaluation. This is a sufficiency test for the direction of a feature under one geometric model; The imposed filling policy makes the effect larger than on the public manuscript. EVA-basic units serve as a proxy for physical width.
scope: The official test preserves the complete line inventory under shuffling. Conditioning each next draw on remaining space gives a directional sequence under this null. A program that sampled the whole line in advance and rejected only on summed length would preserve exchangeability. The ordinary greedy comparison carries the first non-fitting draw to the next line. All methods share the same training length profile. Synthetic lines use their own number of words in book mapping, so the test also permits a different line-length mix.

official_primary.why: the fact also holds on text made without language

reproduction.instructions: Write the embedded source files to one directory. From the pinned repository root run PYTHONPATH=. python3 /path/write_book.py /path and then PYTHONPATH=. python3 /path/audit.py /path. The declaration does not require these scripts to be run by the scorer.

plan.primary_mechanism: A word-table writer observes a fixed line capacity and repeatedly draws an independent word from the pooled length profile conditional on fitting in the remaining space. Every position uses the same rule, and no final-position category is queried. Stop when no positive-length word can fit. Use whole-book line mapping.
plan.fit: Measure certain paragraph word lengths as eva-basic glyph counts pooled on public ZL practice training only. Ordinary width is the nearest-rank 75th percentile of the observed glyph counts plus inter-word spaces for non-paragraph-ending training rows. At a paragraph-ending line, draw a width from the empirical training distribution of clean paragraph endings, capped by the ordinary width. Empty input lines consume no text. Other line units are filled independently with their published token-slot counts. The classifier never receives Currier, section or vocabulary identity labels.
plan.replication: Five seeds 643701, 643702, 643703, 643704 and 643705. Freeze the first seed for the only candidate submitted. Assign synthetic names that preserve the sampled lengths using one uppercase namespace glyph and a stream of unrelated lowercase glyphs. No manuscript phrase is copied.
plan.controls: Compare the same length profile under independent fixed token slots, and greedy wrapping with the first non-fitting draw carried to the next line. Reuse page order and the public paragraph marks in every mode. Measure all runs on the public practice allocation with F-023's declared ratio and intact-word line shuffle. The production of words always follows the preceding capacity, without feedback from any verdict.

scripts.audit.py:
"""Public practice reproduction of the official short-final-word fact attack."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

from measure import flags_from_groups, group_toks, test
from write_book import Writer
from vs import corpus, dsl, ivtff, redteam, registry


def practice_pages(lines):
    _, selected = corpus.split_pages('practice')
    selected_ids={p.id for p in selected}
    stream=iter(lines)
    output=[]
    for page in corpus.pages():
        obj=ivtff.Page(page.id,page.order,dict(page.meta))
        for line in page.lines:
            words=next(stream) if line.words else []
            obj.lines.append(ivtff.Line(line.id,line.page,line.n,line.unit,line.subtype,words,line.para_start,line.para_end))
        if obj.id in selected_ids:
            output.append(obj)
    assert next(stream,None) is None
    return output


def main():
    work=Path(sys.argv[1]); entry=json.loads((work/'frozen.json').read_text()); cfg,shape=entry['settings'],entry['layout']
    seeds=range(643701,643706)
    results={}
    for mode in ('fixed_slots','greedy','capacity_fit'):
        results[mode]=[]
        for seed in seeds:
            lines=list(Writer(cfg,seed).rows(shape,mode))
            sample=practice_pages(lines)
            result=test(flags_from_groups(group_toks(sample)),399)
            if mode=='capacity_fit' and seed==643701:
                assert lines==json.loads((work/'primary-lines.json').read_text())
                official=redteam.fact_attack('F-023',lines,'practice',cut='book')
                assert 'refused' not in official
                assert official['synthetic']['value']==round(result['value'],6)
                assert official['synthetic']['pass']==result['pass']
                exact=dsl.evaluate(registry.get('F-023')['detail']['spec'],sample)
                assert exact['detail']['shuffle_within_line']['p']==round(result['p_upper'],4)
            results[mode].append({'seed':seed,'book_words':sum(map(len,lines)),**result})
    print(json.dumps({'official_primary':official,'public_runs':results},indent=2))


if __name__=='__main__':
    main()
